text: A U.S.-announced Russia-Kuraine energy ceasefire remains disputed amid reported Russian drone strikes on Ukrainian energy facilities. Kyiv reports infrastructure damage and conditions its compliance on Russian adherence. Moscow confirms ongoing contacts without specifying agreement terms.

meta.note: Mutual agreement and operative ceasefire scope remain unverified; reported strikes overlap the declared ceasefire.

text: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford jointly receive the 2026 economics memorial prize for microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stability. Their models incorporate household and business decisions, expectations, and policy communication into macroeconomic analysis.

meta.note: The award recognizes established theoretical contributions rather than a new monetary or fiscal policy action.

text: Starbucks denies plans to acquire Chipotle following reports of takeover advisory activity. Chipotle shares decline nearly 4%, while Starbucks rises 1%. Chipotle's reported defensive advisory arrangements remain separate from Starbucks' public denial.

meta.note: The denial addresses acquisition plans but does not independently resolve reported advisory activity.
